page.layout: One title page: centred text at the top, then a woodcut emblem with a rule below it, then the date line.
page.notes: The woodcut emblem has an oval inscription ring with the legend "SERVATA FIDE[?]" on the left, "I. & W. HARNISCH" on the right, and "DITAT[?]" below. The inner picture shows a sun above a tree and two hands clasping. The ring text is only partly legible and is not transcribed as body text. The date is printed as "cIↄ. Iↄ. xciiX": the first two forms are M and D, and "xciix" looks like a misprint for XCIX (1599), so it is given as printed with [?]. Only the title lines and date are transcribed as text.
